content_sections.heading: ESIC Hospital Ezhukone Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ESIC Hospital Ezhukone Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ESIC Hospital Ezhukone Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Specialist (Full Time/Part Time): MBBS degree with TCMC registration and Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma in concerned speciality. For ICU, PG degree or PG Diploma holders in Anaesthesia/General Medicine/Pulmonology/Critical care and registered with Medical Council. Three years' experience in respective speciality for degree holders or Five years' experience in respective speciality for diploma holders. Senior Resident (1 Year): Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or Diploma in concerned specialty after MBBS with TCMC registration is required. For ICU, PG Degree or PG Diploma holders in Anesthesiology/ General Medicine/ Pulmonary Medicine/ Emergency Medicine/Critical care medicine and registered with Medical Council is required. All post graduate additional qualifications must also be registered with the Medical Council.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Specialist (Full Time/Part Time): Maximum age limit is 69 years. Senior Resident (1 Year): Maximum age limit is 45 years.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Specialist (Full Time): Rs.1,42,514/- per month (approximate amount) Specialist (Part Time): Rs. 60,000/- per month. Additional Rs. 15,000/- admissible as visiting charges in case of emergency (if willing). Rs.800/- for additional every hour, beyond 16 hrs subject to the justification of competent authority. Senior Resident (1 Year): Approximately Rs.1,42,514/- (for PG Degree holders). An amount of Rs.1350/- will be deducted for SRs who possess only Diploma.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Hospital Ezhukone Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by ESIC Hospital Ezhukone?
faq.answer: ESIC Hospital Ezhukone has announced a total of 18 vacancies for the posts of Specialists (Full Time/Part Time) and Senior Residents (1 Year).

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for these positions?
faq.answer: The application mode for these positions is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person with all required documents.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for the ESIC Hospital Ezhukone recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 25 September 2026. Registration will be from 09:00 AM to 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Specialist posts?
faq.answer: For Specialist posts, candidates must possess an MBBS degree with TCMC registration and a Post Graduate Degree/DNB, or a Diploma in the concerned speciality.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Resident posts is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for a Full-Time Specialist?
faq.answer: The salary for a Full-Time Specialist is Rs. 1,42,514/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for female candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for female candidates, PWD candidates, SC/ST candidates, and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is Contractual engagement.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ESIC Hospital Ezhukone located?
faq.answer: ESIC Hospital Ezhukone is located in Kollam, Kerala, with the pincode 691505.
